commit_subject: fix(game): bound aggregate primitive texture cache memory

Third audit fixes. RCON BASIC changes what is played (arena, game mode, map cycle), runs match commands, kicks, bans, restarts and shuts down - not the server's settings (Vars locked in its panel, Clear all of the runtime prefs MASTER only). Masterserver nonces are kept with the address they went to (an additional master can not answer for the main one), an additional master that refuses gets one resend per new cookie. "Suppress client webhooks" is its own flag - the platform always goes out, so itch.io and CrazyGames guests are kept out of ranked, and the reason reaches them (a short linger, as for the nickname kick). An empty identity broker is a failed sign-in, not an endless "Signing in". Connect anyway: the key shown then is checked for the rest of the run; a key learned through the localhost fallback is not remembered under the remote address. A server reads its broker keys once (0x... too) and says "does not accept sign-ins from your identity provider" for a cert in its time from a broker it does not trust. Tournament rosters are normalized (0x... is a key), account rosters force account auth, mixed ones are logged. The web build: no account changes in a second tab or with storage that did not load, no .bak keys kept (old ones removed), a quiet link recheck once a run, a tab the browser blocked is said so; CrazyGames guests get Sign in in Info and the leaderboards' entry back. The Steam build skips the import modal for a key swapped by hand and does not take another Steam account's cert. Backup first in its pane, Link with Steam..., Continue unlinked, clearer linked/forget texts, MMR on linking, "while you can still rejoin (for N minutes)", ranked rechecked at the confirm buttons, hidden modals closed once linked, HTML error pages not pasted into modals, Manage linked keys on any 409, a link that reached the site but not the game is a success with an orange note. The loopback listener waits until it runs (stop right after start no longer hangs). Windows: wide APIs for the key folder and the device name; the account avatar in KEYS_DIR. macOS: the system clipboard and Cmd shortcuts in ImGui. The account avatar is made again only when its bytes change. Leaderboards: an empty or repeated name no longer asserts.
